projectBrief.title: Project 1: SQL Queries on the kaggle_car Database
projectBrief.summary: Write and validate 14 read-only SQL queries over the car sales dataset.
requirements: Submit exactly 14 SQL query statements in order from Q1 through Q14.
Each question must produce exactly one result table.
Use the exact -- begin Qi code and -- end Qi code delimiters; do not put comments inside them.
Do not create or modify tables in the submission.
A CTE, subquery, UNION, INTERSECT, or EXCEPT is still part of one statement.
State comparisons are case-insensitive; car_sales state values may be lowercase.
The tenth VIN character is the model-year code used by Q10.
Return the requested columns, ordering, and row limits. Most questions request the first four rows.
Each query must finish within 20 seconds on the specified laptop.

questions.title: February 2015 sales
questions.prompt: Count February 2015 transaction rows and sum selling_price; repeated VINs count as separate sales.

questions.title: Low-odometer vehicles
questions.prompt: List distinct make, model, body combinations for manufacture years 2012–2015 with known odometer below 20,000, ordered and limited to four.

questions.title: Discounted CA, TX, and FL sales
questions.prompt: Find qualifying sales at least 20% below a positive mmr and calculate price_difference and discount_percent.

questions.title: State names and prices
questions.prompt: Join matching states, keep states with at least 500 sales, and report counts and average selling price for the first four.

questions.title: Selling-price categories
questions.prompt: Classify every transaction as Budget, Common, Luxury, or Super and count each category.

questions.title: Finance sellers
questions.prompt: For non-null sellers containing finance regardless of case, report sales count, distinct VIN count, and average price for the first four.

questions.title: Sales above group average
questions.prompt: Count non-null make/model transactions whose selling price is at least three times the average price for their make/model; use an efficient CTE or window strategy.

questions.title: Exactly one of California or Texas
questions.prompt: Using SQL set operations, find non-null makes sold in exactly one of California and Texas, ordered and limited to four.

questions.title: Repeated VIN sales
questions.prompt: For VINs with at least two transactions, report count, minimum price, maximum price, and price spread for the first four.

questions.title: VIN year-code mismatches
questions.prompt: Find transaction rows whose tenth VIN character disagrees with the code in vin_info for year_manufacture.

questions.title: Make-model versus make average
questions.prompt: For make/model groups with more than 200 transactions, compare the model-group average with the make-wide average, including NULL model groups.

questions.title: Makes present in every large state
questions.prompt: Find non-null makes with at least one sale in every non-null state having more than 5,000 transactions.

questions.title: Top make-model per large state
questions.prompt: For every large state, find the non-null make-model combination(s) with the greatest sales count, preserving ties and returning the first four rows.

questions.title: Inconsistent repeated VIN records
questions.prompt: Find repeated VINs whose recorded make/model values are inconsistent, treating NULL as a missing wildcard according to the brief.
